projects.title: SkyRouter — MSFS Flight Operations & EFB Planner
projects.alt: SkyRouter MSFS flight operations planner with interactive map and vertical situation display
projects.description: A modern, responsive Electronic Flight Bag (EFB) and IFR flight planner designed for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and 2020. Features an interactive Leaflet moving map with satellite layers, live SID/STAR procedure and runway ILS approach selectors, a dynamic Vertical Situation Display (VSD) with waypoint elevations, beginner-friendly aviation tooltips, and one-click native MSFS AceXML (.pln) export.

projects.title: Healthcare Taxation AI Assistant
projects.alt: Healthcare Taxation Assistant user interface showing configuration sidebar and chat interface
projects.description: An advanced RAG-based agentic system designed to interpret complex US Federal and State healthcare tax laws. Implements HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings) and Query Transformations to improve retrieval accuracy for nuanced legal queries. This serves as the core implementation of my M.Tech dissertation.

projects.title: Tavern & Tomb — AI Dungeon Master Web RPG
projects.alt: Tavern & Tomb browser-based AI tabletop RPG party setup and theme configuration interface
projects.description: A browser-based, pass-and-play tabletop RPG game where an AI acts as the Dungeon Master. Features interactive d20 skill check resolution, multi-provider LLM support (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude), character sheet & inventory management, campaign presets, and voice narration.

projects.title: TradeLearner-Sim
projects.alt: TradeLearner Pro market dashboard with live price cards and options chains
projects.description: A high-fidelity trading simulator designed to teach complex financial derivatives through gamification. Features real-time OHLC candlestick charts, a functional options chain (Calls/Puts), and live P&L tracking.

projects.title: Startup CEO - A business simulation game
projects.description: A high-fidelity business engine simulating the complexities of scaling a multi-industry conglomerate. Features a 'Product Forge' for cross-sector innovation, localized staff management (HR), and dynamic unit economics (Burn Rate vs. ARPU). Implements a real-time corporate treasury and valuation tracking system.
